name: qfd_dv_s5_xhead3b

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every input at its pin (stage P) and drives every output from a flop; flow pin registers would add unpriced cycles

reset_landing.reason: the RTL lands rst_n in ot_rst_relay (2 sync stages + 12 kept regional relay copies)

fill_reason.pin_bound: 5,726 signal pins (a_d 1,567 E, lw 2,340 W, corridor 1,032 N, leaf read 776 S) set the outline; logic ~12k flops

safe_design_checklist.1_pins: PASS: every input lands in a pin flop (stage P: p_g/p_ib/p_f/p_foff x3, cid_q, lqp/lqvp/lqbp, fi_q); every output is a flop Q (lw/lc kept per-chain regs, lr0_*, n_q/s_q with the retag moved before them, fault_r, l_rst_n = relay copy); rst_n -> ot_rst_relay 2 sync + 1 kept relay stage
safe_design_checklist.2_reach: PASS: 259.2 x 518.4 tile, every hop < 405 um
safe_design_checklist.3_fanout: PASS (mapped census): native census PASS 0 drivers > 32 (max 32, was 75 / 2,585), rst_n 14 sinks (ot_rst_relay), 12,127 flops, 6,091 um2 mapped; depth 390.1 ps / 12 levels; kept register copies, no buffer trees
safe_design_checklist.4_depth: PASS (mapped textbook depth): see census; no adder after adder in one stage, registered one-hot selects
safe_design_checklist.5_storage: PASS: largest indexed arrays: windows e_W[2][16] x 18 + e_lo[2][16] x 6 = 768 b, epoch fields 2 x 71 b: < 2 kb
safe_design_checklist.6_floorplan: pin-bound leaf (no macros, full std-cell area): pins spread over whole faces by pin_ranges ({'N': 4.16, 'E': 3.08, 'W': 4.59, 'S': 3.1} pins/um); aspect 2.0:1
safe_design_checklist.7_clock: one centre-fed TritonCTS root (~12k sinks, one region); io_hold_margin 0.03
safe_design_checklist.8_schedule: +1 edge on every a_d path (fill -> leaf write, go/ib -> corridor DX 14 -> 15, read request issue), +1 reset release (3 edges incl. l_rst_n); lq answers and fault_i -> fault latency unchanged; all intra-column relative timing (FILL_LEAD 5, QD 8, TDM) unchanged; throughput unchanged (a go every >= 8 k tiles edges as before)
